events.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Use voice for Q&A during Read Aloud in Word

events.titleEn: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Use voice for Q&A during Read Aloud in Word

events.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Reference an attached PowerPoint deck’s style when creating a new presentation with Agent Mode in PowerPoint
events.titleEn: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Reference an attached PowerPoint deck’s style when creating a new presentation with Agent Mode in PowerPoint
events.summary: When creating a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint using Agent Mode, you can reference an existing PowerPoint file, so Copilot applies its theme and styles to the new deck, keeping the design consistent. events.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Data Loss Prevention to safeguard sensitive information from external web search in Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat
events.titleJa: Microsoft Purview で外部 Web 検索向け DLP 保護を強化
events.titleEn: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Data Loss Prevention to safeguard sensitive information from external web search in Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat
events.summary: We are expanding Microsoft Purview DLP for Microsoft 365 Copilot to safeguard web searches containing sensitive data. This real-time control helps organizations mitigate data leakage and oversharing risks by preventing Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from using sensitive data for external web search.
events.summaryJa: 機密データを含む Web 検索を保護するために、Microsoft Purview DLP for Microsoft 365 Copilot を拡張しています。このリアルタイム制御は、Microsoft 365 Copilot および Copilot Chat が外部の Web 検索に機密データを使用することを防ぎ、組織がデータ漏洩と過剰共有のリスクを軽減するのに役立ちます。
events.summaryEn: We are expanding Microsoft Purview DLP for Microsoft 365 Copilot to safeguard web searches containing sensitive data. This real-time control helps organizations mitigate data leakage and oversharing risks by preventing Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from using sensitive data for external web search.
events.importanceReason: 管理やガバナンスへの影響が大きいため / 会議やコミュニケーションの業務導線に直結するため

events.titleJa: Excel の Copilot を使用した複雑な Web 検索
events.titleEn: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Complex web search with Copilot in Excel
events.summary: We have decided not to move forward with this change at this time. We apologize for any inconvenience. Copilot in Excel improves complex web search quality with a multi-agent search system that coordinates parallel research, verifies findings, and re-checks gaps when needed, delivering faster and more complete answers...
